print.description: Display a char or str to the monitor

input.description: Read a char from the keyboard

wozm.description: Exit the programm and return to Woz Monitor. Go to the adress FF1F: `GETLINE` routine.

return function.description:
Return a value.
Can't be used outside function.

asm_entry.description: Add a code in assembly for MOS 6502.

restart.description: Restart the programme (go to the start adress).

elif.description: Condition elif (used if the fisrt condition is False).

else.description: Condition else (used if all condition are False).

import.description: Import a module. Shearch in all path if not keyword 'from'.

from.description: Shearch a module on spesific directory. Muste be: 'smart' (builtin module), 'lib' (global librairiy), 'file' (from any file, relative of absolute path).

while.description: while loop. If condition is false, the loop is exited.

for.description: for loop. Iterate with start to end with step or iterate on an advenced value (`str` or `list`).

for-step.description: The start, end and step of a for loop.

break.description: Go out of loop. Can't be used outside loop.

continue.description: Restart loop. Can't be used outside loop.

error.description: Set a runtime error. Print `E` and the value next error keyword (the code error).

f-string.description: F-String. You can set `{}` on string for set a value.

compiletime-debug.description: compiletime debug keyword. Set after True, 1, False, 0 for active or remove debug mode.

compiletime-define.description: compiletime define keyword. Replace the name by the value at compile time.

compiletime-realloc.description: compiletime realloc keyword. Reallocate the adress of a variable to another variable.

compiletime-log.description: compiletime log keyword. Print a message on log of compiller.

shebang.description: Run Smart file with shebang on Linux. Add --console for show output on terminal.

try-except.description: Run the `try` block. If a runtime error occured, run the `except` block.

thread.description: Open a second thread. Use with carfull on MOS6502.

thread-nostack.description: Open a thread without stack. The thread can't call function.

thread-stack.description: Open a thread with shared stack.
